items.title: What Does McKesson (MCK) Gain From Its Push Into Oncology And Clinical Research?
items.summary: McKesson (NYSE:MCK) announced an agreement to acquire Precision Medicine Group to expand its oncology and clinical research services. The deal is aimed at deepening McKesson's role in personalized medicine and specialty care, particularly in oncology and biopharma clinical trial support. The acquisition is expected to reshape McKesson's service mix across oncology practices, biopharma partners and clinical research organizations.
